The answer key was checked against Texas and NRC radiography rules (25 TAC §289.255, 10 CFR Part 34) and standard radiography data. Charts, meter faces, dosimeters and diagrams were redrawn; equipment photos are manufacturer product images (QSA Global/SENTINEL, SPEC, NDS Products). Words in [brackets] were unreadable in the source video and were filled in from context. Your exam will give you its own data sheet, so use its values.
